extension.name: express-transaction-monitor
extension.title: Express: Real-Time Transaction Monitor
extension.description: Stream live data to the browser as it happens with an Express app using Server-Sent Events, and let a team act on it together. It monitors a simulated feed of bank card transactions, sends the suspicious ones to a shared review queue, and attributes each acknowledge or escalate to the signed-in viewer using their Connect identity. A starting point for any live, collaborative dashboard; point the stream at your own source, like a message queue, a database change feed, or a webhook.
